# Extended Password Patterns
# Password shapes built from a word plus a predictable suffix or prefix: name + year, word + '123', symbol-padded words.
# License: CC0-1.0 - Original compilation authored for WiFi Fortress; no third-party word list, corpus or leaked password dump is included.
